roadmap.title: Campaign and Resurrection
roadmap.description: Finish both campaigns on any difficulty. Attempt the four combat challenges in Missions 1, 2, 5 and 11; mission select lets you retry them later.

roadmap.title: Arcade scenarios
roadmap.description: Clear the first tier of every Light Side and Dark Side Battle Scenario. Higher tiers are optional.

roadmap.title: Troopers, heroes and ground modes
roadmap.description: Use online Co-op for class abilities, hero kills and rank XP. Rotate through all 14 launch heroes in Heroes vs Villains, and earn wins in Blast, Strike, Galactic Assault and Heroes vs Villains.

roadmap.title: Starfighters and multiplayer cleanup
roadmap.description: Work on Bomber, Fighter and Interceptor tasks while earning a Starfighter Assault win. Finish the five launch-mode wins, 25 multiplayer milestones and overall Rank 50. If a lobby is quiet, try another Ping Site under Options > EA Account.

achievements.description: Shock three campaign enemies together with Iden’s Droid.
achievements.summary: Shock three campaign enemies together with Iden’s Droid.

guide.context: If the group scatters or dies, restart the checkpoint. You can also replay The Cleaner through mission select.

steps.text: In @loc{The Cleaner}, take the rifle and defend the Droid while it opens the door near the @loc{Reach the MC80 Airlock} objective.
Wait for at least three Rebels coming down the stairs to gather together. Aim at the group and activate @mechanic{Droid Shock} once the ability is charged.

achievements.description: Kill five campaign enemies during a single Barrage activation.
achievements.summary: Kill five campaign enemies during a single Barrage activation.

guide.context: The five kills can span all three shots. If the activation ends without enough kills, restart the checkpoint or replay The Battle of Endor.

steps.text: In @loc{The Battle of Endor}, continue to @loc{Reach Platform 4}. After the cutscene, take the @item{Barrage} from the weapon crate inside the bunker.
Equip Barrage and use its three shots to kill at least five Rebels in the woods ahead. Keep Barrage equipped until you have five kills.

achievements.description: Shoot down eight enemy starfighters during the campaign’s Battle of Jakku.
achievements.summary: Shoot down eight enemy starfighters during the campaign’s Battle of Jakku.

guide.context: Flying too close to the first objective stops TIE Fighter spawns. Restart the checkpoint if this happens, or replay The Battle of Jakku through mission select.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{The Battle of Jakku}, use the X-wing to destroy eight TIE Fighters before approaching @loc{Reach the Distress Beacons}.

achievements.description: Kill a Scout Trooper with Iden’s stealth melee takedown in the campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill a Scout Trooper with Iden’s stealth melee takedown in the campaign.

guide.context: An alerted melee kill does not count. If you are spotted, restart the checkpoint; mission select also lets you replay The Storm.

steps.text: In @loc{The Storm}, leave the Future Leaders School and pass through the concourse to the next outdoor encounter, near @loc{Reach Kestro Defense Center}. Stay hidden while the marching Stormtroopers pass.
Crouch behind the @enemy{Scout Trooper} and press melee before anyone detects you. On default PC controls, melee uses the middle mouse button.

achievements.description: Complete 25 Multiplayer Milestones.
achievements.summary: Finish 25 milestones across the multiplayer categories.

guide.context: Campaign and Arcade milestones do not contribute.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Career} and work on milestones in Multiplayer, Troopers, Heroes and Starfighters until your combined completed total reaches 25.

achievements.description: Win a match of Starfighter Assault.
achievements.summary: Secure a multiplayer victory in Starfighter Assault.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Starfighter Assault} until your team wins a match.

achievements.description: Reach Rank 25.
achievements.summary: Raise your overall multiplayer rank to 25.

guide.context: Wednesday triple XP and weekend double XP speed up rank progress.

steps.text: Earn multiplayer XP until the overall rank shown in @mechanic{Career} reaches 25. Online @mechanic{Co-op} is a useful way to gain XP.

achievements.displayName: The Force is Strong With This One
achievements.description: Reach Rank 50.
achievements.summary: Raise your overall multiplayer rank to 50.

guide.context: Individual character levels do not replace overall rank. Wednesday triple XP and weekend double XP shorten the grind.

steps.text: Keep earning multiplayer XP until @mechanic{Career} shows overall Rank 50. Use online @mechanic{Co-op} to work on class and hero achievements alongside rank progress.

achievements.description: In Multiplayer, defeat 3 enemies within one Vanguard usage 5 times.
achievements.summary: Kill three multiplayer enemies during one Vanguard activation on five occasions.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Assault} in online @mechanic{Co-op}. Use an enclosed area, such as Death Star II or Jabba’s Palace, to find enemies close together.
Activate @mechanic{Vanguard} and kill three enemies before the ability expires. Complete five successful activations across your matches.

achievements.description: In Multiplayer, boost 100 allies with the Officer commands.
achievements.summary: Apply Officer command boosts to allies 100 times in multiplayer.

guide.context: The counter tracks allies boosted, so one command can add several boosts. Progress carries across matches.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Officer} in online Co-op or Supremacy. Stand near teammates and use @mechanic{Battle Command} when they are in range. Keep boosting allies until the total reaches 100.

achievements.description: In Multiplayer, defeat 150 enemies with the Heavy's Sentry Gun.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 150 multiplayer kills with the Heavy’s Sentry gun.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Heavy} in online @mechanic{Co-op}. Use @mechanic{Sentry} whenever it is ready and build up 150 kills across your matches.

achievements.description: In Multiplayer, get 25 headshots with longblaster rifles.
achievements.summary: Score 25 multiplayer headshot kills using longblaster rifles.

steps.text: Use a @mechanic{Specialist} primary rifle in online @mechanic{Co-op} and aim for enemies’ heads until you have 25 headshot kills.

achievements.description: Get 20 Killstreaks with Interceptor ships.
achievements.summary: Earn 20 multiplayer killstreaks of at least two kills in Interceptor-class ships.

steps.text: Select an @mechanic{Interceptor} in @mechanic{Starfighter Assault}. Destroy two enemy ships without losing your ship; AI ships count.
Earn a two-kill streak on 20 separate lives. Using separate lives gives you a clear way to count the required streaks.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 enemies using Dual Proton Torpedoes with the Bomber ship class.
achievements.summary: Score 50 multiplayer kills with a Bomber’s Dual Proton Torpedoes.

steps.text: Choose a @mechanic{Bomber} in @mechanic{Starfighter Assault}. Avoid Unknown Regions and D’Qar, where the available factions have no Bomber class.
Weaken an enemy ship with lasers, then lock on and fire @mechanic{Dual Proton Torpedoes} to finish the kill. Slow AI bombers marked as attacking objectives make useful targets when you defend.
Build up 50 torpedo kills across matches. The torpedoes must deliver the killing blow.

achievements.description: Defeat 25 Hero ships with Fighter ships.
achievements.summary: Destroy 25 enemy Hero ships while flying Fighter-class ships in multiplayer.

guide.context: Assists do not count. Hero Starfighters needs four players to start; groups can select the same Ping Site and queue together, but the lobby remains public.

steps.text: Choose a regular @mechanic{Fighter} in @mechanic{Starfighter Assault}. Find enemy Hero ships and land the killing blow on 25 of them across matches.
Alternatively, enter @mechanic{Hero Starfighters}. Crash your starting Hero ship while a teammate stays alive, then respawn as a Fighter and destroy enemy Hero ships.

achievements.description: Complete all unique Battle Scenarios.
achievements.summary: Clear the first tier of all 16 Arcade Battle Scenarios.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Play > Single-Player > Arcade > Battle Scenarios}. Finish tier 1 in each of the eight Light Side scenarios and each of the eight Dark Side scenarios.

achievements.displayName: There is No Such Thing As Luck
achievements.description: Engage in an Arcade match.
achievements.summary: Take part in an Arcade match.

steps.text: Start an @mechanic{Arcade Battle Scenario} and play through the challenge.

achievements.displayName: Ignore Your Instincts At Your Peril
achievements.description: Destroy 25 objectives in Starfighter Assault.
achievements.summary: Destroy 25 marked enemy objectives in Starfighter Assault.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Starfighter Assault} and attack enemy targets marked as objectives. Deliver the final hit on 25 objectives across matches.
When defending, prioritize AI bomber waves that carry enemy objective markers. These ships count toward the total.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 enemies in Heroes Vs Villains.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 50 enemy kills in Heroes vs Villains.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Heroes vs Villains} and stay close to your teammates while fighting enemy heroes. Build up 50 kills across matches.

achievements.description: Be the first one to defeat an enemy in a Multiplayer match.
achievements.summary: Score the first enemy kill of a multiplayer match.

steps.text: Enter a fresh online @mechanic{Co-op} match and reach the first enemies quickly. Kill an enemy before any other player scores a kill; AI enemies count.

achievements.displayName: Do. Or Do Not. There is no Try.
achievements.description: Play as all launch heroes in Multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Enter multiplayer combat as each of the 14 launch ground heroes and villains.

guide.context: Use Heroes vs Villains and change characters after deaths. You only need to spawn as each character; a full match with each is unnecessary.

guide.context: Kills combine across characters, maps and matches. Starfighter Assault and Ewok Hunt do not contribute.

steps.text: Play online @mechanic{Co-op} as a ground hero or villain and kill AI enemies until your combined hero kill total reaches 500.
